cases.input: I just ran ult-repo-layout init in my project — can you open the browser wizard so I can see the resolved What/How boxes and pick a directory for my content?
cases.notes: Canonical trigger: launch the browser wizard to view resolved boxes and use the directory picker, after ult-repo-layout has already run.

cases.input: Can I check what layer and slot paths ult-repo-layout resolved for this repo through a local read-only status page instead of opening context-config.yaml by hand?
cases.notes: Status-check trigger, distinct phrasing from case 01 (reading resolved layer/slot state via a status page vs. launching the wizard directly).

cases.input: In our automated pipeline, add a check that exits non-zero if any registered path mapping no longer resolves to a real folder — this needs to execute unattended with no windows or manual clicking.
cases.notes: Headless/CI-only layout validation — exactly the case this skill's 'Do NOT use for headless/CI-only layout validation' clause redirects to ult-repo-layout's own validate_layout.py --validate instead.
